name: B-value Distribution Validation
description: Validate b-value shell distribution. (From the UK Biobank schema.)
implementation:
# value has unique DiffusionBValue rows with a Count column
b_values = value["DiffusionBValue"]
counts = value["Count"]

b0_count = counts[b_values < 50].sum()
b1000_count = counts[(b_values >= 900) & (b_values <= 1100)].sum()
b2000_count = counts[(b_values >= 1900) & (b_values <= 2100)].sum()

if b0_count < 8 or b0_count > 12:
  raise ValidationError(f"Expected ~10 b=0 images, found {b0_count}")

if b1000_count < 45 or b1000_count > 55:
  raise ValidationError(f"Expected ~50 b=1000 images, found {b1000_count}")

if b2000_count < 45 or b2000_count > 55:
  raise ValidationError(f"Expected ~50 b=2000 images, found {b2000_count}")
